platform-feedback.purpose: Own platform-feedback behavior, read models, UI contracts, and admin review surfaces.
platform-feedback.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

request-support.purpose: Provide request API clients shared by experience-owned route modules and prompt UI.
request-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for context-local request composition.
request-support.justification: request-support centralizes the Experience API client for route modules and browser prompt UI.
request-support.createdFor: platform-feedback routes and contextual prompt submissions.
request-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move behavior back into feature-local modules.

shell-support.purpose: Provide Experience admin shell composition for deployable layout routes.
shell-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for admin-web shell composition.
shell-support.justification: shell-support keeps admin shell composition outside feature modules.
shell-support.sunsetWhen: Remove if Experience no longer contributes admin-web routes.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide event-store, schema, and projector composition for the Experience context.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for context runtime composition.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes event-store composition for the platform-feedback slice.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when platform feedback no longer needs runtime composition.

seed-support.allowedWhen: Allowed for bootstrap and test data.
seed-support.justification: seed-support centralizes deterministic identifiers for sample platform feedback.
seed-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when sample platform feedback is no longer seeded.

routes.purpose: Expose experience-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
